commands.command: set -e; EXPECTED=0acd5545253bf1cdde580b0c220c6a09c3ae2fcc; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 0.5; PID=$(adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | tr -d '[:space:]'); test -n "$PID"; echo app_pid=$PID; echo '=== ps rss ==='; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell ps -A -o PID,RSS,NAME | grep "^[[:space:]]*$PID[[:space:]]" || true; echo '=== ps threads ==='; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell ps -AT -o PID,TID,NAME | awk -v p="$PID" '$1==p {n++} END {print "ps_thread_count=" n+0}' || true; echo '=== proc status ==='; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell sh -c "cat /proc/$PID/status 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(VmRSS|Threads):'" || true; echo '=== proc fd ==='; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell sh -c "ls -1 /proc/$PID/fd 2>/dev/null | wc -l" || true; echo '=== lsof ==='; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell lsof -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null | head -n 5 || true; echo lsof_count=$(adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell lsof -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {n++} END {print n+0}'); echo '=== dumpsys meminfo ==='; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell dumpsys meminfo "$PID" | grep -E 'TOTAL PSS:|TOTAL RSS:|TOTAL:' | head -n 5 || true; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; echo telemetry_source_probe_done=true
